speaker: Doctor
text:
The patient mentions scleral icterus and severe pruritus alongside fatigue; these signs strongly suggest jaundice and biliary pathology rather than pneumonia. Please describe any changes in your stool color or urine appearance, and tell me if you have noticed any abdominal pain or fever.

REQUEST TEST: Liver function panel (ALT, AST, ALP, Bilirubin, Albumin, PT/INR).
REQUEST IMAGES: Abdominal Ultrasound.

speaker: Measurement
text: RESULTS: ALT 78 U/L, AST 75 U/L, Alkaline_Phosphatase 460 U/L, Bilirubin_Total 1.5 mg/dL, Bilirubin_Direct 0.9 mg/dL. Abdominal Ultrasound: Thickening of the bile ducts and focal bile duct dilatation.

speaker: Doctor
text:
The ultrasound confirms extrahepatic biliary obstruction, indicated by the thickened and dilated bile ducts alongside elevated alkaline phosphatase. Given your history of severe pruritus and the presence of scleral icterus, have you experienced any weight loss or night sweats recently?
